examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A relative range (`Last 15 minutes`) that stays relative: the value is `{ type: 'relative', amount, unit }`, re-resolved against the clock on every query. The panel has two tabs, Absolute and Relative, and opens on Relative here because the value is relative (any other value, or none, opens Absolute). Absolute shows the month grid first (click a start day and an end day), then the start and end date and time, typed or picked from a 30-minute list; Relative has a custom duration and unit on top and the quick ranges below. Refresh every sets the auto-refresh interval. The panel is as thin as the calendar, names the zone in a read-only line, and commits nothing until Apply. On a phone it opens as a full-width sheet from the bottom of the screen.

examples.name: Absolute
examples.summary: `range-selector-mode="absolute-only"` with a `max`: only the grid and the date and time fields, the trigger prints the range in the zone with its UTC offset, and Apply refuses an end before the start or past the limit with an inline message.

examples.name: RelativeOnly
examples.summary: `range-selector-mode="relative-only"` with the default quick ranges (Today to Last year) above the custom duration, for a metrics interval that is always measured back from now.

examples.name: WithStep
examples.summary: `show-step` adds Previous and Next around the trigger; each moves the range by its own length (an hour back, an hour forward) and Next stops at the present. A range inside one day prints its date once (`Nov 10, 13:00 – 14:00`), and the trigger text wraps instead of being cut off when the space is narrow.

examples.name: UntilNow
examples.summary: An absolute start that ends now: turn on **End at now** on the Absolute tab and the value becomes `{ type: 'since', start }`. The trigger reads `Nov 10, 2026, 9:30 – now`, the end moves with the clock on every query, and Next stays disabled.

examples.name: AutoRefresh
examples.summary: Refresh every is in the panel by default (Off, 10 seconds … 1 hour). Bind `v-model:refresh-interval` (seconds, 0 is off) and run the query on `@refresh`, which fires on each tick while the page is visible; the trigger shows a refresh icon and says the interval to screen readers. A page that cannot re-run its query passes `:show-refresh="false"`. The quick ranges start with **Today** and **This week**: options with `snap: true` begin at the start of the day or week in the time zone.

examples.name: TimeZone
examples.summary: `v-model:time-zone` and `show-time-zone` with a short list of zones: the zone selector appears in the panel, the absolute range is typed and shown in the chosen zone, and the stored value stays the same ISO instants, printed under the picker.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: A disabled picker keeps its range visible; the trigger and the step buttons do not respond.
